question_urdu: فری لانسنگ کیسے شروع کروں بغیر تجربے کے؟
question_english: How do I start freelancing with no experience?
answer_key_points: 1. Pick ONE skill (content writing/data entry/graphic design) 2. Learn free on YouTube for 2-3 weeks 3. Create 3-5 sample projects 4. Open Fiverr account first (easier than Upwork) 5. Price low initially to get reviews 6. Increase rates after 5-star reviews
resources_to_mention: Fiverr YouTube tutorials Canva for design samples

question_urdu: کون سی پروگرامنگ لینگویج پہلے سیکھوں؟
question_english: Which programming language should I learn first?
answer_key_points: Depends on goal: Web development = JavaScript | Data/AI = Python | Mobile = Dart/Flutter | General = Python (most versatile). Don't overthink - any language teaches programming concepts. Python recommended for beginners.

question_urdu: 30 سال کی عمر میں ٹیک میں کیریئر سوئچ ممکن ہے؟
question_english: Can I switch to tech career at 30?
answer_key_points: Absolutely! 30 is young. Many successful developers started late. Your previous experience is ADVANTAGE - domain knowledge is valuable. 6-12 months dedicated learning can get you job-ready. Focus on practical skills not degrees.
resources_to_mention: Success stories of late starters Google Career Certificates

question_urdu: ڈالر میں پیمنٹ کیسے لوں پاکستان میں؟
question_english: How to receive dollar payments in Pakistan?
answer_key_points: Main options: 1. Payoneer (most popular) 2. Wise (good rates) 3. Direct bank wire (for large amounts) 4. Freelancer platforms hold and transfer. Avoid PayPal - not available in Pakistan. Keep records for tax purposes.

question_english: How to improve my Upwork profile?
answer_key_points: 1. Professional photo 2. Specific headline (not 'web developer' but 'React Developer for E-commerce') 3. Portfolio with 3-5 best works 4. Client testimonials if available 5. Take Upwork skill tests 6. Lower rate initially for first 5 jobs

question_urdu: لیپ ٹاپ کون سا لوں ڈویلپمنٹ کے لیے 100K میں؟
question_english: Which laptop for development under 100K PKR?
answer_key_points: Key specs needed: 8GB RAM minimum (16GB better) | SSD 256GB+ | i5 or Ryzen 5+. Brands in budget: Lenovo IdeaPad HP Pavilion Dell Inspiron. Used ThinkPads are excellent value. Avoid gaming laptops (expensive for features you won't use).
resources_to_mention: PakWheels/OLX for used laptops Laptop comparison sites

question_urdu: گھر سے کام کرتے ہوئے productive کیسے رہوں؟
question_english: How to stay productive working from home?
answer_key_points: 1. Dedicated workspace (even a corner) 2. Fixed working hours 3. Get dressed like going to office 4. Use Pomodoro technique (25 min work 5 min break) 5. Tell family your work hours 6. Use app blockers for social media during work
resources_to_mention: Pomodoro apps Focus apps Forest app

question_urdu: انگلش کیسے بہتر کروں ٹیک جاب کے لیے؟
question_english: How to improve English for tech jobs?
answer_key_points: 1. Watch English YouTube daily (tech channels) 2. Read documentation in English 3. Write English journal daily 4. Practice speaking alone or with language partners 5. Don't aim for perfection - clear communication is enough. Technical vocabulary matters more than accent.
resources_to_mention: English YouTube channels Grammarly Language exchange apps

question_urdu: AI سے میری جاب جائے گی کیا؟
answer_key_points: AI will change jobs not eliminate them. Focus on: 1. Skills AI can't do (creativity relationship-building complex decisions) 2. Learning to use AI tools 3. Staying adaptable. Those who learn AI will be more valuable not less.

question_urdu: فری لانسنگ بمقابلہ جاب - کون سا بہتر؟
question_english: Freelancing vs Job - which is better?
answer_key_points: Both have pros/cons. Job: Stable income learning environment structure career growth. Freelancing: Higher earning potential flexibility independence. Recommendation: Start with job to learn then freelance part-time then decide.
resources_to_mention: Comparison guides success stories both paths
